# Phase 116's probe of DIFFERENCES: every input file and every case.
# Written by testdata/dif116/gen.go; read by govax's oracle tests.
#
# file NAME [FORMAT]   an input file in [DIF116.IN] (a name again is its
#                      next version); its records follow, one per "|" line,
#                      with \\, \t, and \xNN escapes; FORMAT is FIX n, VFC,
#                      or STMLF (variable when absent)
# case ID SECTION OUT  a case: OUT is "file" (its listing in
#                      [DIF116.OUT]ID.DIF) or "log"; then
#   title TEXT         what it shows
#   pre COMMAND        a DCL line run before it
#   command COMMAND    the DIFFERENCES line, without /OUTPUT
#   post COMMAND       a DCL line run after it
#

case A01 LAYOUT file
  title two records inserted (the author's example)
  command DIFFERENCES A01.TXT A01.TST
case A01L LAYOUT log
  title the same, to the log
  command DIFFERENCES A01.TXT A01.TST
case A02 LAYOUT file
  title one record changed in the middle
  command DIFFERENCES A02.A A02.B
case A03 LAYOUT file
  title two records deleted in the middle
  command DIFFERENCES A03.A A03.B
case A04 LAYOUT file
  title the first record changed
  command DIFFERENCES A04.A A04.B
case A05 LAYOUT file
  title the last record changed
  command DIFFERENCES A05.A A05.B
case A06 LAYOUT file
  title records inserted at the start
  command DIFFERENCES A06.A A06.B
case A07 LAYOUT file
  title records appended
  command DIFFERENCES A07.A A07.B
case A08 LAYOUT file
  title the last records deleted
  command DIFFERENCES A08.A A08.B
case A09 LAYOUT file
  title the first records deleted
  command DIFFERENCES A09.A A09.B
case A10 LAYOUT file
  title the master empty
  command DIFFERENCES A10.A A10.B
case A11 LAYOUT file
  title the revision empty
  command DIFFERENCES A11.A A11.B
case A12 LAYOUT file
  title both empty
  command DIFFERENCES A12.A A12.B
case A12L LAYOUT log
  title both empty, to the log
  command DIFFERENCES A12.A A12.B
case A13 LAYOUT file
  title identical files
  command DIFFERENCES A13.A A13.B
case A13L LAYOUT log
  title identical files, to the log
  command DIFFERENCES A13.A A13.B
case A14 LAYOUT file
  title nothing in common
  command DIFFERENCES A14.A A14.B
case A15 LAYOUT file
  title two sections
  command DIFFERENCES A15.A A15.B
case A16 LAYOUT file
  title changes one record apart
  command DIFFERENCES A16.A A16.B
case A17 LAYOUT file
  title changes two records apart
  command DIFFERENCES A17.A A17.B
case A18 LAYOUT file
  title changes three records apart
  command DIFFERENCES A18.A A18.B
case A19 LAYOUT file
  title a 200-byte record changed
  command DIFFERENCES A19.A A19.B
case A19W80 LAYOUT file
  title the same at /WIDTH=80
  command DIFFERENCES/WIDTH=80 A19.A A19.B
case A20 LAYOUT file
  title tabs, trailing blanks, blank records
  command DIFFERENCES A20.A A20.B
case A21 LAYOUT file
  title line numbers of five and six digits
  command DIFFERENCES A21.A A21.B
case A22 LAYOUT file
  title a block moved up
  command DIFFERENCES A22.A A22.B
case A23 LAYOUT file
  title repeated records
  command DIFFERENCES A23.A A23.B
case A24 LAYOUT file
  title a change with an insertion after it
  command DIFFERENCES A24.A A24.B
case M16_1 MATCHING file
  title changes one record apart, /MATCH=1
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=1 A16.A A16.B
case M18_1 MATCHING file
  title changes three records apart, /MATCH=1
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=1 A18.A A18.B
case M23_1 MATCHING file
  title repeated records, /MATCH=1
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=1 A23.A A23.B
case M16_2 MATCHING file
  title changes one record apart, /MATCH=2
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=2 A16.A A16.B
case M18_2 MATCHING file
  title changes three records apart, /MATCH=2
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=2 A18.A A18.B
case M23_2 MATCHING file
  title repeated records, /MATCH=2
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=2 A23.A A23.B
case M16_3 MATCHING file
  title changes one record apart, /MATCH=3
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=3 A16.A A16.B

  title changes three records apart, /MATCH=3
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=3 A18.A A18.B
case M23_3 MATCHING file
  title repeated records, /MATCH=3
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=3 A23.A A23.B
case M16_5 MATCHING file
  title changes one record apart, /MATCH=5
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=5 A16.A A16.B
case M18_5 MATCHING file
  title changes three records apart, /MATCH=5
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=5 A18.A A18.B
case M23_5 MATCHING file
  title repeated records, /MATCH=5
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=5 A23.A A23.B
case M01 MATCHING file
  title /MATCH larger than either file
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=50 A02.A A02.B
case M02_W1 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=1
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=1 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W2 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=2
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=2 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W3 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=3
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=3 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W5 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=5
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=5 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W8 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=8
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=8 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W9 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=9
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=9 M02.A M02.B
case M02_W20 MATCHING file
  title eight records inserted, /WINDOW=20
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=20 M02.A M02.B
case M03_W1 MATCHING file
  title eight records changed, /WINDOW=1
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=1 M03.A M03.B
case M03_W4 MATCHING file
  title eight records changed, /WINDOW=4
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=4 M03.A M03.B
case M03_W8 MATCHING file
  title eight records changed, /WINDOW=8
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=8 M03.A M03.B
case M03_W9 MATCHING file
  title eight records changed, /WINDOW=9
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=9 M03.A M03.B
case M04 MATCHING file
  title a block moved, /WINDOW=2
  command DIFFERENCES/WINDOW=2 A22.A A22.B
case M05 MATCHING file
  title /MATCH=1/MERGED=1
  command DIFFERENCES/MATCH=1/MERGED=1 A15.A A15.B
case F01 FORMS file
  title the base pair, merged by default
  command DIFFERENCES F01.A F01.B
case F02 FORMS file
  title /MERGED=0
  command DIFFERENCES/MERGED=0 F01.A F01.B
case F03 FORMS file
  title /MERGED=2
  command DIFFERENCES/MERGED=2 F01.A F01.B
case F04 FORMS file
  title /MERGED=3
  command DIFFERENCES/MERGED=3 F01.A F01.B
case F05 FORMS file
  title /MERGED=5/MATCH=5
  command DIFFERENCES/MERGED=5/MATCH=5 F01.A F01.B
case F06 FORMS file
  title /SEPARATED
  command DIFFERENCES/SEPARATED F01.A F01.B
case F07 FORMS file
  title /SEPARATED=MASTER
  command DIFFERENCES/SEPARATED=MASTER F01.A F01.B
case F08 FORMS file
  title /SEPARATED=REVISION
  command DIFFERENCES/SEPARATED=REVISION F01.A F01.B
case F09 FORMS file
  title /SEPARATED=(MASTER,REVISION)
  command DIFFERENCES/SEPARATED=(MASTER,REVISION) F01.A F01.B
case F10 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL F01.A F01.B
case F11 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL=1
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL=1 F01.A F01.B
case F12 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL=3
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL=3 F01.A F01.B
case F13 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL/WIDTH=80
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL/WIDTH=80 F01.A F01.B
case F14 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL/WIDTH=40
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL/WIDTH=40 F01.A F01.B
case F15 FORMS file
  title /NONUMBER
  command DIFFERENCES/NONUMBER F01.A F01.B
case F16 FORMS file
  title /PARALLEL/NONUMBER
  command DIFFERENCES/PARALLEL/NONUMBER F01.A F01.B
case F17 FORMS file
  title /WIDTH=80
  command DIFFERENCES/WIDTH=80 F01.A F01.B
case F18 FORMS file
  title /WIDTH=200
  command DIFFERENCES/WIDTH=200 F01.A F01.B
case F19 FORMS file
  title /MODE=HEXADECIMAL
  command DIFFERENCES/MODE=HEXADECIMAL F01.A F01.B
case F20 FORMS file
  title /MODE=OCTAL
  command DIFFERENCES/MODE=OCTAL F01.A F01.B
case F21 FORMS file
  title /MODE=(HEX,ASCII)
  command DIFFERENCES/MODE=(HEX,ASCII) F01.A F01.B
case F22 FORMS file
  title /MODE=(OCTAL,HEX,ASCII)
  command DIFFERENCES/MODE=(OCTAL,HEX,ASCII) F01.A F01.B
case F23 FORMS file
  title /MODE=HEX/WIDTH=80
  command DIFFERENCES/MODE=HEX/WIDTH=80 F01.A F01.B
case F24 FORMS file
  title /CHANGE_BAR on the verb
  command DIFFERENCES/CHANGE_BAR F01.A F01.B
case F25 FORMS file
  title /CHANGE_BAR=# on the verb
  command DIFFERENCES/CHANGE_BAR=# F01.A F01.B
case F26 FORMS file
  title /CHANGE_BAR=(#,NONUMBER)
  command DIFFERENCES/CHANGE_BAR=(#,NONUMBER) F01.A F01.B
case F27 FORMS file
  title /CHANGE_BAR=("!",NUMBER)/NONUMBER
  command DIFFERENCES/CHANGE_BAR=("!",NUMBER)/NONUMBER F01.A F01.B
case F28 FORMS file
  title /CHANGE_BAR/NONUMBER
